835| def _start_subtask(state: WorkflowState, sid: str) -> bool:
836|     """Lease + attempt bookkeeping on the control-loop thread, then submit the
837|     executor call to the pool. Returns False when the subtask cannot start."""
838|     plan = state["plan"]
839|     store = state["store"]
840|     ctx = state["ctx"]
841|     sub = P.find_subtask(plan, sid)
842|     assert sub is not None
843|     legacy = P.is_legacy(plan)
844|     lease = store.get_lease(sid)
845|     resume_obj: ResumeState | None = None
846|     record = _intervention(ctx)
847|     run_resume = state.get("resume")

345|     def _owns_current_attempt(self) -> bool:
346|         """True while this attempt still owns the subtask's execution lease.
347| 
348|         A takeover bumps the attempt number and installs a new lease. From that
349|         moment this recorder belongs to a superseded attempt: anything it writes
350|         (conversation state, run status) is a late result and must not touch the
351|         newer attempt's state. Read paths (tool steps) are still recorded, since
352|         the work really happened and the step carries its attempt number.
353|         """
354|         return P.lease_matches(self._store.get_lease(self._sid), self._sid, self._attempt)

356|     def heartbeat(self, state: str | None = None) -> None:
357|         with self._ctx.lease_lock:
358|             lease = self._store.get_lease(self._sid)
359|             if not P.lease_matches(lease, self._sid, self._attempt):
360|                 return
361|             if lease.get("state") == "released":
362|                 return
363|             lease = dict(lease)
364|             lease["heartbeat_at"] = utc_now()
365|             if state:
366|                 lease["state"] = state
367|             self._store.set_lease(lease)
